methodology_notes: Primary event evaluation policy is strict.
B_76_sqrt was selected over D_125_sqrt based on multi-seed event robustness, not window-level Macro-F1 alone.
Three independently trained GRUs are combined by arithmetic mean of class probabilities.
Balanced and Quiet profiles passed local robustness criteria on the development validation set.
Safety profile was CORE_ONLY and is not considered frozen.
AI Hub official Validation-derived data has been extensively used for development and model selection.
The internal test split is not an untouched final test.
Staged-clip FA/hour must not be interpreted as household false alarms per hour.
Final thresholds require long continuous ADL negative evaluation.
Deployment pose resolution/backend must be validated on Raspberry Pi 5.
